title: The Dundies
logline: Michael hosts a mandatory awards night at Chili's, a toast meant for Jan turns into a rumor that he's proposing, and Pam gets honest over margaritas.
outline: A: Michael forces mandatory Dundies at Chili's and plans a toast to Jan; a half-said "our future" spreads by telephone into a rumor he's proposing, and the night ends in a silence he can't fix. B: Pam dreads Roy's no-show; Jim drives her home after she gets honest over margaritas and admits Roy never noticed her earrings. C: Creed makes homemade trophies and Stanley counts days; at Chili's only Kevin is happy. Order: cold, A, B, C, A, B, A, B, C, A, B, A, tag.
theme: Being seen: the awards are a way of asking to be noticed, and the people who notice you are often closer than you think.
storySoFar: Michael is desperate for Jan's approval after the Idol flop; Jan keeps sending maybes and voicemails. He has now forced mandatory Dundies at Chili's, with Dwight as emcee. Jim and Pam keep pranking Dwight (the latest: a stapler in lime Jell-O); Jim noticed Pam's earrings and Roy didn't. Roy keeps postponing the wedding and stood Pam up again. Angela and Dwight's secret is an open office joke that nobody says aloud. Toby is still not invited to things, but Michael keeps setting out chairs for him. Creed is in Scrantonicity with Kevin and Stanley, and Stanley is counting down to retirement at 216 days. Kevin still says "Nobody say nothing."

stateChanges.status: closer; Jim drove Pam to Chili's and then home after Roy didn't show; Pam admitted he noticed her earrings
secret still unspoken; Angela asks Dwight to check things for her and thanks him in public

stateChanges.progress: Mandatory Dundies were a flop except for Kevin; Michael's toast to Jan became a proposal rumor and died in silence; Michael cried into a tissue Pam gave him in the Chili's parking lot, and Toby sat in his car with him

stateChanges.arc: Will They, Won't They: Jim and Pam
stateChanges.progress: Pam admitted over margaritas that Roy never looks at her; Jim said he noticed her earrings; Roy noticed the earrings two hours late and got it wrong

stateChanges.text: Jan sent another voicemail, this time saying she is not coming; Michael kept it
Toby has a folding chair at Chili's that he never sat in; Michael and Toby sat in Michael's car instead
Creed says he has already retired several times and gave himself a Dundie that is in a safe in Ohio
Kevin: 'Nobody say nothing.' Michael's Jan-related toasts end in silence
Stanley counts days to retirement: 216 at Chili's, 215 the next morning
Dwight's Jell-O trophy from Jim: a lime mold labeled 'Dwight Schrute, Quality Dessert'

scenes.recap: Dwight finds his stapler frozen in lime Jell-O again and the Jell-O won't stop jiggling.

beats.caption: slides a stapler sealed in lime Jell-O into Dwight's desk drawer

beats.text: Question: who has been putting lime Jell-O in my desk?
Maybe the Jell-O wants a promotion.
False. Jell-O has no ambition. Only people do.

beats.caption: pulls the stapler out of the Jell-O block; it jiggles
The Jell-O keeps jiggling

scenes.recap: Michael announces mandatory Dundies at Chili's and a toast to someone who may or may not show up.

beats.text: Dundies. Tonight. Chili's. Six o'clock. Attendance is mandatory, and by mandatory I mean I will be counting.
Do I have to stay for the trophies or just the chili?
You have to stay for the whole thing, Stanley. That's the spirit of the Dundies.
Question: who is emcee? Me. The answer is me.
Categories. Whitest Sneakers. Most Mysterious. Best Chili. And Dwight will hand out the Jell-O award.
I got one of these in Ohio. The mayor had a lot of questions.
Chili good. Best chili.
And before the awards, a toast to someone very special. She may or may not be there.
Jan?
Nobody say nothing.

beats.caption: Nobody says nothing

beats.text: Actually, Jan's voicemail said maybe. Maybe is not yes.

scenes.recap: Pam reads Roy's text saying he'll try to swing by, and Jim offers her a ride.

beats.text: Roy texted. He said he'll try to swing by.
Try to swing by the Dundies?
He says awards are 'not really his thing.' He's been saying that about everything.

lines: Roy said he'd try. Roy tries a lot. It's kind of his hobby.
I used to think trying was the same as showing up.

beats.caption: buys two orange sodas from the vending machine

beats.text: If he doesn't show, I'll drive you.
You don't have to do that.
I know.

beats.caption: The vending machine hums

beats.text: Okay. Yes.

scenes.recap: Creed glues plastic Dundies onto shakers and reminds Stanley how many days he has left.

beats.caption: glues a plastic Dundie onto a salt shaker

beats.text: What is that?
A trophy. I've given myself four. The one in the safe in Ohio is the good one.
Two hundred and sixteen days.
Two hundred and sixteen. I've retired several times. It went fine.

lines: Stanley counts. I watch. Nobody asks what I do here.
I'm Quality Assurance. The quality is assured.

beats.text: What do you actually do here?
Quality Assurance, Stanley. I'm assuring it.

scenes.recap: Michael tells Ryan he's toasting Jan about their future, and Kelly hears the word proposal.

beats.text: Ryan, I'm going to toast Jan tonight. Something about our future.
Don't do a speech. Do a pitch. Make it scalable.
Did Michael just say future? Ryan, he said future!
Kelly, I don't care what he said.
He's proposing! At Chili's! Michael, you're proposing to Jan!
What? No. It's a toast. Like, cheers. Our careers.

beats.caption: texts a group chat: MICHAEL IS PROPOSING AT CHILI'S

scenes.recap: The proposal rumor reaches the kitchen, and Angela demands the Chili's private room be checked by Dwight.

beats.text: I heard Michael's proposing to Jan at Chili's. I'm just so happy for them.
Over my dead Fall Harvest Potluck.
False. Michael is not proposing. He would have told me first.

lines: Chili's does not have a private room for proposals. I know because I asked.
I asked Dwight to ask. He asked. He always asks correctly.

beats.text: Dwight. Thank you for checking.
You are welcome, Angela.

beats.caption: Dwight and Angela share a look nobody mentions

scenes.recap: Michael arrives at Chili's, tells Toby he is not invited, and sets out a folding chair anyway.

beats.text: Welcome to the Dundies. Chili's. Put your hands together for Chili's.
Michael, I'm supposed to be here. I'm HR.
Toby, you are not invited.
Okay.
There's a folding chair behind the potted plant. It's not an invitation. It's a chair.

lines: I didn't invite Toby. I put out a chair. A chair is not an invitation.
A chair is just a chair that's waiting.

beats.text: Question: is the chair for Toby, or for the trophies?
Dwight. Everything is for the trophies.
I'm only here to check the brand.
Ryan, I'm going to be on the news for this.

scenes.recap: Pam sips margaritas and admits Roy never notices her, and Jim says he noticed her earrings.

beats.text: Roy's not coming. He sent a thumbs up.

beats.caption: sips a second strawberry margarita and winces

beats.text: A thumbs up is basically a hug, for Roy.
He hasn't looked at me in a year, Jim. He looked at my earrings for two seconds. Today.

beats.caption: that's a lot of honesty for one margarita

beats.text: I noticed the earrings.
Why did you notice?
Because I notice things. They're really good earrings.

lines: Roy didn't notice the earrings. I noticed the earrings.
That's the only thing I'm going to say about it.

beats.text: Don't tell anyone I'm drunk.
You had one.
It was a big one.

scenes.recap: Only Kevin is happy at the Dundies, while Meredith gets drunk and Creed tells a story about a kidnapping uncle.

beats.caption: eats chili with both hands, beaming

beats.text: Best night.
Stanley, you're the only one not smiling. That's my favorite. Also, I'm drunk.
Two hundred and sixteen days.
A man at a Chili's in Tallahassee got kidnapped by his own uncle. Fine food.
That's terrible, Creed.

lines: Michael said this is mandatory. I said I'd come for the free chili.
Kevin is the only one who read the memo.

scenes.recap: Michael hands out the Dundies, Pam wins Whitest Sneakers, and his toast to Jan ends in silence.

beats.text: Whitest Sneakers. Pam Beesly. Come on up.

beats.caption: walks up and accepts a spray-painted sneaker on a plaque

beats.text: Pam, your sneakers are very white. It's an honor.
They're Keds. Thanks. I think?
Michael, is this the part where you propose?
What? No. Kelly, no.
False. Michael is not proposing. Michael does not propose to anyone at Chili's.

beats.caption: hands Jim a lime Jell-O mold trophy to give to Dwight

beats.text: Dwight Schrute. Quality Dessert.
I deserve this. I accept it.
And now, a toast. To Jan. Who isn't here. Who sent a candle.

beats.caption: Someone coughs

beats.text: I just want her to know I'm ready. For whatever's next. That's what she said.

beats.caption: The room says nothing

beats.text: Nobody say nothing.
Michael, the room is ours at nine.

scenes.recap: Roy finally shows up late and says nice earrings, and Pam leaves with Jim.

beats.text: Hey, Pam. Sorry. Route 6 was a mess.
I won Whitest Sneakers.
Cool. Are those the wedding earrings?
No. I've had these for two years. Jim's the one who noticed.
Oh. Huh. Yeah, they're nice.
Jim's driving me home, Roy.

lines: Roy said nice earrings. Two years late and kind of a guess.
It was a confident guess, though. I'll give him that.

scenes.recap: Michael sits in his car crying into a tissue, and Toby sits in the passenger seat.

beats.caption: sits in the driver's seat holding a tissue Pam gave him

beats.text: Michael, you can't drive crying.
I'm not crying. It's the chili.

beats.caption: Toby sits in the passenger seat anyway

beats.text: Did you want to come in? To the dinner?
Yes.
You couldn't come. But you can sit in my car.

lines: I put out a chair for Toby. He didn't take it.
That's how I know he's the only one who gets it.

beats.caption: They sit in the car and nobody says anything

scenes.recap: The next morning, Stanley counts down, Dwight displays his Jell-O trophy, and Kevin repeats his line.

beats.text: Two hundred and fifteen.
Dundies good. Chili better.

beats.caption: places the lime Jell-O trophy on his desk, where it jiggles

beats.text: Question: who gave me the trophy? Jim. Who wobbles? Also Jim.
Nobody say nothing about last night.

beats.caption: The Jell-O keeps jiggling
